summary: Iteration 2 focused testing of 4 NEW features (Weather, Voice-First Onboarding, Crop Photo Diary, Notifications) + light regression. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py covering /api/weather (lat/lon, place, invalid place 404, missing params 400), /api/farm/extract (populates crop/soil/irrigation/growth_stage/location and correctly leaves un-mentioned 'variety' empty; auth-required; empty text 400), /api/diary CRUD (upload multipart JPEG -> id+storage_path, list contains it, GET /image returns image/jpeg bytes, DELETE soft-deletes and disappears from list, auth-required), and /api/daily-plan now accepts a weather field. Frontend (mobile 390x844, geolocation granted): register->home works, WeatherCard auto-fetches via saved coords and shows temp/humidity/rain/wind + 3-day forecast (weather-card visible with real Chennai data ~28°C Overcast), Home shortcut-diary navigates to /diary, add-photo-btn opens file picker, uploading a small JPEG saves and photo renders via blob URL (blob: image src confirmed), MyFarm at /my-farm add-farm-btn opens sheet with 'Speak to set up' text and a mic button (see minor issue re data-testid), manual Save Farm succeeds, Settings toggle-notifications flips label from 'Turn on notifications' -> 'Notifications are on' after permission grant, regression Try Demo->Analyze produces assessment-result.
action_items: OPTIONAL/testability: The review request stated the MyFarm add-form VoiceButton exposes data-testid='voice-record-btn', but in the small (non-big) VoiceButton variant used by MyFarm the testid is 'voice-mic-btn' (voice-record-btn is only on the big variant used by /assess). The mic button is present and functional; consider unifying the testid or adding both so future automated tests using the documented id don't miss it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 662 lines with weather, extract and diary added. Continues to mix concerns; recommend splitting into routers (weather.py, diary.py, farm.py) especially now that object storage helpers live in the same file.
put_object/get_object use synchronous 'requests' inside async endpoints -> blocks the event loop under load. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool.
/api/diary uses ObjectId(item_id) without try/except -> a malformed id will return 500 (bson.errors.InvalidId) instead of 404. Wrap in try/except and raise 404.
DELETE /api/diary does not verify a document was matched; it returns {ok:true} even for non-existent ids. Should check matched_count and return 404 when 0.

Uploaded diary files are not MIME/content sniffed (only trusts filename extension) - light abuse vector, and 10MB limit is checked AFTER await file.read(). For very large uploads consider stream/chunk check.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True still present (carried over from iteration 1).
/api/farm/extract: if LLM returns non-JSON despite strip_json, endpoint returns 502 - handled, but no retry.
test_credentials: admin@kisanmitra.ai / admin123; suite also registers ephemeral TEST_it2_<uuid>@test.com and TEST_ui_* / TEST_ui2_* users via /api/auth/register
seed_data_creation: test_new_features.py uploads one JPEG generated in-memory with Pillow and deletes it during the delete test; teardown_module logs in and DELETE /api/account/data to clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run new-feature suite with: `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_new_features.py -v -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini forces xdist which is not needed). Frontend Playwright needs mobile viewport (390x844), grant_permissions(['geolocation','notifications']) and set_geolocation to test weather-card. Register form uses tab 'Create Account' (not a link 'Register'). Farm route is /my-farm (not /farm). VoiceButton in MyFarm renders with data-testid='voice-mic-btn' (small variant); big variant on /assess uses 'voice-record-btn'. Diary blob images fetched via /api/diary/{id}/image and rendered through DiaryImage component using URL.createObjectURL. Weather uses Open-Meteo (no key needed) so it works even without EMERGENT_LLM_KEY reachable.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Minor testid mismatch documented above.
